# StoatMD

> Local-first Markdown notebook. Sync with Google Drive or Dropbox. Buy once to unlock sync for you and your AI agents.

- Site: https://stoatmd.com
- Product: StoatMD (macOS first; iOS / iPad planned)
- Pricing: local editing free forever; sync unlock is a one-time purchase (price TBA — do not invent a price)
- Sync providers (v1): Google Drive, Dropbox only (no iCloud, no self-hosted server, no WebDAV in v1)
- Editing model: plain Markdown source + separate preview (edit / split / preview), not WYSIWYG
- Agents: vault on Drive/Dropbox so remote agents can read/write the same library without a local MCP bridge
- Platforms listed: macOS (Coming soon), iOS/iPad (Planned). Windows/Linux not listed.
